competitors.what_they_have: The competitor to beat: Japanese-run practice, page updated 28 Oct 2026, titled with 税理士申告 and 定額料金. Visible fixed fees per year, a 5-step process with timings (return sent within 24 hours, lodged next morning, refund 7-12 business days), Trustpilot reviews, an 帰国後でも利用可 claim, an ABN section. Also amplified by nichigopress.jp advertorials that rank for 税理士 おすすめ. Gaps: no FAQ block, no Medicare exemption, no refund-account rule, no official sources cited.

Long guide written by a CPA: what a tax return is, who must lodge, tax tables, deductions, records, deadlines incl. the agent lodgment program (15 May), Medicare exemption note, 'about 7 to 8 in 10 use a registered tax agent (登録税理士)'. Uses resident rates (not WHM 15%), no FAQ, no official links; links to Ezy.
Advertorial for a Sydney firm: price list (from $165), LINE in Japanese, 日本からでも, Medicare claims and remittance to a Japanese bank account listed as services. No steps, no FAQ, no sources.

Association guide (Aug 2025): deadline tables, documents list, refund 2-3 weeks, agent extension, DIY steps, case stories. Outdated rates (19%/32.5%, super 9.5%), lodging after return mentioned without steps, no Medicare.
Blog comparison agent vs DIY in a table (fee, effort, language, refund timing). Outdated (2023, payment summaries), but the comparison-table format is what 'おすすめ' searchers click.

summary_of_gap: Our page is the only one with a full 7-step process, refund mechanics and a sign-before-lodging rule, but it has no answer-first summary, no dated key-figures block with official source names, does not answer the 税理士 question in the words people search, has no FAQ on the Japanese bank account, Medicare exemption, early lodgement before 30 June or how the fee works, and in three places it says or implies that the business lodges the return (fix first).

facts.fact: Working holiday maker tax rate 15% up to $45,000, 30% from $45,001 to $135,000, effective 1 July 2026, unchanged from 2025-26
Working holiday makers cannot claim the tax-free threshold; 15% applies from the first dollar
Withholding where no TFN is on file: 45%

Medicare levy 2% of taxable income; exemption for periods not entitled to Medicare requires a Medicare Entitlement Statement from Services Australia; ATO: 'You must wait until you receive your MES before lodging your tax return' (page updated 22 June 2026)
Japan is not a Reciprocal Health Care Agreement country
Self-lodgement deadline 31 October; 2025-26 was 31 October 2026 (passed); late returns can still be lodged; 2026-27 runs 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027

Registered tax agents 'are the only people that can charge a fee'; agents must be registered with the TPB and the TPB public register can confirm registration; new clients should contact an agent before 31 October to be part of their lodgment program (updated 24 April 2026)
From outside Australia you can lodge via myTax, a registered tax agent or paper, and you need 'an Australian bank account you can use to receive any refund amounts' (updated 24 April 2026)

Leaving permanently before 30 June with no further Australian-sourced income (other than interest, dividends, royalties): early lodgement on the paper form; 'Processing for early lodgments is 50 business days' (updated 15 June 2026)

NOTE FOR LEAD, no change proposed: ATO says 'Most online returns are processed within 12 business days' (updated 20 July 2026). The page's owner-approved 'おおむね14営業日' is more conservative and consistent with it; keep.
Approved JA wording used: supervision 'オーストラリアの登録タックスエージェントの監督のもとで運営'; sign-off 'ATOに提出される前に、オーストラリアの登録タックスエージェントが確認し、承認します'
